mechanism: Build multi-symbol log-return matrix (assets as rows, bars as columns), compute full covariance Σ via OpenBLAS Cov(), then compare naive portfolio vol sqrt(sum w_i^2 Var_i) against true vol sqrt(w^T Σ w). Hidden gap = true_vol − naive_vol; gap_percent = hidden_gap/naive_vol. Positive gap means co-movement inflates portfolio risk beyond single-instrument ATR/std sizing.
data_needed: Aligned multi-symbol close series; log returns; portfolio weights summing ~1; lookback N bars; Cov() and MatMul/Dot.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAUUSD; PERIOD_H1; LookbackBars=100 default
why_new_for_mis: MIS can sense when multi-instrument books are systematically under-risked by single-name volatility tools, using the signed hidden-gap % as a live co-movement risk sensor.
quote: The hidden risk gap is +0.0054%, and expressed as a percentage of the naive estimate, the gap is +4.66%.

mechanism: Re-run the naive-vs-true portfolio risk gap over different LookbackBars windows. Gap widens when EURUSD/GBPUSD correlations tighten under strong dollar directionality or macro events (NFP, Fed), and narrows in quiet range-bound periods—so the gap trajectory itself marks correlation-regime shifts.
data_needed: Rolling or alternative lookback windows on the same multi-symbol log-return matrix; repeated true/naive vol comparisons.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, XAUUSD; H1; variable lookback (default 100 bars ≈ four trading weeks)
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a continuous correlation-regime-change probe without needing an external event calendar—gap expansion/contraction tracks when shared-factor risk is tightening.
quote: During periods of strong dollar directionality or major scheduled events, the correlations between EURUSD and GBPUSD tighten significantly, and the gap will widen. During quieter, range-bound periods with less macro direction, the gap may narrow.

mechanism: After Cov() on multi-asset log returns, call native Eig() to get eigenvalues/eigenvectors; sort by eigenvalue descending; report Factor k risk share = λ_k / sum(λ). Warn when Factor 1 share > 70% (portfolio essentially one-dimensional). Example run: Factor 1 = 91.24% (almost pure XAUUSD), Factor 2 = 7.82% (USD FX factor), Factor 3 = 0.93% (EUR/GBP differential).
data_needed: Symmetric asset×asset covariance; Eig(eigenvectors, eigenvalues); total variance = sum of eigenvalues.
why_new_for_mis: Dominant eigenvalue share is a portfolio concentration/regime sensor that reveals when diversification is illusory—orthogonal to single-name vol or pairwise correlation alone.
quote: Factor 1 holds 91.24% of total portfolio variance. That is not a mild concentration warning — it means nine tenths of all the risk in this portfolio is coming from a single underlying factor.

mechanism: For each sorted factor, print eigenvector loadings per symbol. Same-sign large loadings ⇒ instruments share that driver; opposite signs ⇒ differential/spread factor; near-zero ⇒ orthogonal to the factor. Used to map which symbols are expressions of the same bet (e.g. EURUSD and GBPUSD both load heavily on Factor 2 dollar direction).
data_needed: Eigenvectors columns paired with sorted eigenvalues; symbol labels.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an interpretable factor-loading map that attributes portfolio risk to named shared drivers rather than opaque pairwise cov cells.
quote: Factor 2 is the shared currency pair driver — broad US Dollar direction — which we might have expected to dominate if XAUUSD were not in the portfolio.

mechanism: Reconstruct covariance via Â = V Λ Vᵀ (Lambda.Diag, Transpose, chained MatMul), form residual = cov_original − cov_reconstructed, quantify with Frobenius norm and max absolute cell error. Pass if max_error < 1e-10 (example residual ~2.54e-21). Acts as a numerical integrity gate before trusting eigenvalue risk sensors. Also notes Factor 1 share drifts across windows (91.24% → 92.87%) as bars roll.
data_needed: Eig outputs V and λ; Diag/Transpose/MatMul; FrobeniusNorm of residual.
why_new_for_mis: Provides a deployable self-check that factor/covariance sensors remain lossless within floating-point precision before MIS acts on concentration or loading readings.
quote:
Frobenius Norm of Residual: 2.54e-21
Maximum Cell Absolute Error: 2.54e-21
RESULT: Reconstruction agrees within floating-point precision.

mechanism: Primary RSI threshold crossovers propose side; secondary Random Forest meta-classifier receives 27 contextual features at the signal bar and outputs success probability p. Skip if p < 0.55; else size = clip((p−0.5)/0.5, 0, 1). Labels from triple-barrier (±1.5 ATR, 24-bar vertical). Even with 48% OOS accuracy, filter+sizing cut max DD 93% on EURUSD H1 by exposure control in adverse trending regimes (e.g. 2022 Fed hike).
data_needed: RSI signals; 27 features at signal bar; triple-barrier labels; RF probability; walk-forward split.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2018–2021; test 2022–2024; ATR(14), RSI(14)
why_new_for_mis: Separates side prediction from bet/regime validity sensing—MIS can gate and size classical mean-reversion signals by learned context probability rather than fixed ADX thresholds.
quote: The primary model handles side prediction. The secondary model handles bet prediction.

mechanism: Among 16 time features, five session-volatility columns (20-bar rolling std of log returns masked to Sydney/Tokyo/London/NY/overlap, lagged 1) carried 25.6% total RF MDI importance vs 2.5% for binary session-open flags. Magnitude of recent session activity dominates presence flags; same pattern for trend_vel (4.6%) vs above_ema50 (0.1%).
data_needed: H1 bars with UTC session masks; rolling session log-return std; Fourier hour/dow/doy; get_time_features.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; sessions Sydney 21–06, Tokyo 00–09, London 07–16, NY 13–22 UTC
why_new_for_mis: Directs MIS session sensing toward recent per-session realized volatility intensity rather than boolean session-open indicators.
quote: the five binary session flags together carry 2.5% of total importance; the five session-volatility columns carry 25.6%.

mechanism: Feature vol_ratio = ATR(14) / ATR 50-bar mean; values above ~1.5 flag elevated-volatility environments where RSI mean-reversion premises are less reliable. Used as a contextual input to the meta-classifier alongside adx, trend_stretch, dist_high/low.
data_needed: ATR(14), ATR rolling 50-bar mean at signal bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; ATR(14) vs 50-bar ATR mean
why_new_for_mis: Simple relative-vol spike sensor that conditions mean-reversion signal quality without requiring a full regime HMM.
quote: A ratio above 1.5 indicates an elevated-volatility environment where mean-reversion premises are less reliable.

mechanism: Two-time-scale realized volatility on tick mid/bid prices: TSRV = RV_slow − (n_slow/n_fast)×(RV_fast − RV_slow), floored at 0. Combines tick-by-tick RV with slower resampled RV (typical slow_freq 5min) to remove microstructure noise while retaining high-frequency information.
data_needed: Tick-level prices (bid/ask); slow sampling frequency; log returns at both scales.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD ticks; slow_freq examples 1min/5min/15–30min; M1 tick bars in pipeline demo
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a microstructure-noise-aware realized-vol estimator from ticks that is more accurate than sparse bar RV for high-frequency regime/vol sensing.

mechanism: Before final meta-model training, compute Numba-accelerated rolling accuracy/precision/recall/F1 over windows 20 and 50 on prior label vs prediction streams (weighted). These eight rolling meta-features feed the classifier so it conditions on recent model competence; example run ranked rolling_accuracy_20 as top feature (importance 0.166).
data_needed: Aligned y_true, y_pred, sample weights; rolling windows; purged CV pipeline.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD; BollingerBand strategy; tick or time M1 bars; train windows e.g. 2022–2023
why_new_for_mis: Turns recent classifier self-performance into a live sequence sensor—MIS can down-weight signals when rolling meta-accuracy deteriorates.
quote: These features tell the model how well it's been doing recently, which can improve meta-labeling performance.

mechanism: Stepwise refactor of a primitive applied-price/SMA indicator into CSubIndiBase, CSubIndiRegistry, CIndicatorBase, params-isolation via inheritance. Software architecture for reusable MQL5 indicators; no market regime/vol/liquidity sensor is constructed.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic chart symbol; ENUM_APPLIED_PRICE line and SMA(period) demo

quote: we will develop a framework for portable, reusable, and maintainable indicators.

mechanism: On each new H1 bar, fetch last FETCH=24 closes for XAGUSD, XAGEUR, EURUSD; growth = close[0]/close[FETCH−1]. Short XAGUSD when eurusd_growth<1 AND xageur_growth>1 AND xagusd_growth<1; long when all three invert. Uses FX purchasing-power logic across dual-quoted silver as a real-time cross-market confirmation of move strength instead of waiting for same-symbol confirmation.
data_needed: Synchronized closes for the three symbols; growth ratios over fixed lookback; optional trailing SL.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAGUSD (trade), XAGEUR, EURUSD; PERIOD_H1; FETCH=24 bars; backtest Nov 2023–Jan 2025
why_new_for_mis: Triangular growth co-movement is a multi-symbol regime/strength sensor that can accept/reject single-name setups from connected FX-commodity quotes in near real time.
quote: By analyzing the performance of these 3 markets at the same time, we can essentially create a strategy that may not always need to wait for confirmation.

series_key: multiple symbol analysis with python and mql5
mechanism: Normalize and overlay XAGUSD vs XAGEUR cumulative growth; observed persistent decoupling/re-convergence implies temporary mispricing/arbitrage between dollar and euro silver quotes. Spread expansion/contraction is treated as a cross-venue relationship signal feeding the triangular rules and later ML features.
data_needed: Paired XAGUSD and XAGEUR close histories; normalized growth series.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAGUSD, XAGEUR (and EURUSD for triangle); H1; training through Oct 2023
why_new_for_mis: Dual-currency quote decoupling is a liquidity/relative-pricing sensor for multi-listed commodities that MIS can monitor independently of directional alpha.
quote: The two markets clearly decouple for some time, before they are subsequently corrected.
